annotations.title: Read and check a safety data sheet (OSHA HazCom)

description: Parse the text of a GHS safety data sheet into signal word, hazard and precautionary statements, pictograms, ingredients (CAS numbers with check digits verified), exposure limits, flash point, PPE and revision date; check it against 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D; and build a workplace label.
